findings.description: Under Charter Amendment No. 29, the Board of Park Commissioners conveyed the M. H. de Young Memorial Museum building, its contents and its grounds in Golden Gate Park, held in trust since M. H. de Young's deed to the board, to the museum's newly organized Board of Trustees.

findings.address_as_written: Sunset Tunnel - pit head in Duboce Park
findings.description: Because the only space for a pit head at the east portal of the Sunset Tunnel (Duboce Avenue route) was the southwest part of Duboce Park, the Board of Park Commissioners granted the Youdall Construction Company its use for up to eighteen months, the contractor to remove trees and shrubs under Superintendent McLaren and restore the ground afterward.
